note: Repeated paragraphs are expected in this corpus and are reported, not removed: protocol §6 rule 8 requires every occurrence of a duplicated CLAUSE to be annotated. Running furniture (letterhead, page headers, disclaimers, signature blocks) is not a clause, is flagged is_boilerplate by the segmenter, and is excluded from the retrieval index, the P2 sweep and gold spans.
